TURN MY INQUIRIES INTO INTELLIGENCE

A lead is not the same as an opportunity.

Real estate organizations receive inquiries from website forms, email, phone, referrals, advertising, and social media. The problem isn't always generating another lead—it's knowing what is actually inside the lead before your agents pick up the phone.

Buyer Intelligence

RRU structures reported buyer information around key operational factors:

  • Property & geographic preferences
  • Timeline & move-in expectations
  • Budget & financing context
  • Readiness, stated goals & missing info

Seller Intelligence

RRU organizes reported seller information to streamline initial outreach:

  • Property characteristics & details
  • Seller objectives & timeline
  • Property context & stated expectations
  • Readiness & follow-up considerations
